newsitem.title: USA: NPC to buy 100 Pizza Hut units.
newsitem.headline: NPC to buy 100 Pizza Hut units.

text.p: NPC International Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent with franchisee Jamie Coulter to acquire 100 Pizza Hut units and associated development areas for $57 million.

The properties are located in North Carolina, with 18 units; Texas, three units; Tennessee, nine units; Illinois, 10 units; Delaware, 13 units; Colorado, seven units; Nevada, five units; Utah, five units; Arizona, one unit; Oregon, 25 units; and Washington, four units.
The 82 restaurants and 18 delivery carry-out units generated nearly $59.75 million in sales in 1996, NPC said.

NPC said the transaction is expected to close in late May and will be financed through the issuance of long-term debt and additional borrowings under its existing $175 million revolving credit facility.
This agreement follows another letter of intent announced previously to acquire 52 units from Pizza Hut Inc, a PepsiCo unit. This acquisition is expected to close in June.
Assuming consummation of these transactions, NPC will have acquired 328 Pizza Hut units during the last 24 months.
"We are elated by the opportunity to acquire one of the outstanding operations in the Pizza Hut system," Gene Bicknell, chairman, said in a statement.
He added the majority of the units acquired fill in existing territories while the remainder provide an initial foothood in new markets, such as Delaware and Portland, Ore.
NPC, the world's larest Pizza Hut franchisee, operates 544 Pizza Hut restaurants and delivery kitchens in 14 states.
